entities.summary: Tsuneo Watanabe  was a Japanese journalist, businessman, and newspaper editor and executive, who served as a Managing Editor of Yomiuri Shimbun from January 1985 until his death in December 2024. He also served as a Representative Director and Managing Editor of Yomiuri Shimbun Holdings, which published a largest Japanese daily newspaper, Yomiuri Shimbun, and substantially controls the largest Japanese television commercial network Nippon Television Network, and as well as his owner, director, and chief advisor of Yomiuri Giants baseball team, his owner of Japanese amusement park Yomiuriland, and the chairman of Japan Newspaper Publishers and Editors Association.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As Managing Editor of Yomiuri Shimbun from January 1985 until his death in December 2024, Tsuneo Watanabe played a significant role in shaping Japan's media landscape and influencing the country's politics and society. His leadership helped establish Yomiuri Shimbun as one of Japan's largest and most influential newspapers.
